# CaliLawyer.com
> CaliLawyer.com is a Glendale firm for California personal injury and lemon law. We take cases in Glendale, Burbank, Pasadena, and Los Angeles. Attorney: Rober A. Terziyan, State Bar of California No. 351959. Free consultation. Phone: (310) 331-0310. Languages: English, Armenian, and Spanish.

- [Personal injury](https://calilawyer.com/injury): Generally 2 years from the injury (CCP §335.1). Public-entity claims generally must be presented within 6 months (Gov. Code §911.2).
